headline: Senior DevOps Engineer & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
summary_html: Senior DevOps Engineer specializing in Cloud Platform Engineering with 10+ years of experience building resilient multi-cloud platforms across Azure and AWS, driving Kubernetes modernization, automating complex infrastructure with Terraform and CloudFormation, and engineering secure enterprise networking for mission-critical workloads. Deep expertise in AKS, EKS, Karpenter, KEDA, Azure DevOps Pipelines, VNets, Subnets, Private DNS Zones, Private Endpoints, ADLS, Azure Load Balancer, serverless architectures, and observability platforms. Proven track record of reducing operational toil, optimizing compute spend, hardening cloud security posture, and bridging complex systems-engineering rigor with modern DevOps execution.

achievements.text: Reduced Amazon EKS compute costs by nearly 60% through Spot-based node group strategies, mixed-instance fleets, and Kubernetes workload scheduling optimization.
Designed secure AKS networking architectures using VNets, subnet segmentation, private endpoints, service endpoints, and private DNS zones to eliminate public exposure of internal services.
Built enterprise-grade CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions to automate build, validation, containerization, and Kubernetes deployments across multiple environments.
Led Kubernetes platform modernization initiatives including AKS upgrades, node pool optimization, autoscaling improvements, and workload reliability enhancements.
Standardized infrastructure provisioning across Azure and AWS using modular Terraform architectures enabling repeatable multi-environment platform deployments.

impact.text: Engineered secure Azure network topologies using VNets, subnets, NSGs, VNet peering, private DNS zones, private endpoints, and service endpoints, eliminating unnecessary public exposure for platform and data workloads.

Led AKS platform upgrades, Kubernetes version transitions, node pool refreshes, and workload optimization efforts, improving cluster stability, reducing upgrade risk, and maintaining platform performance for containerized applications.

Built and standardized Azure DevOps pipelines for build, validation, container image creation, infrastructure deployment, and AKS release automation, improving release consistency and reducing manual deployment effort.
Reduced EKS compute spend by 60% by designing spot-instance-based node group strategies and mixed-instance capacity patterns for high-throughput financial workloads.
Implemented event-driven autoscaling using KEDA with SQS-based triggers, improving responsiveness during transaction spikes and aligning pod capacity with live queue demand.
Developed reusable and versioned Terraform modules to standardize provisioning across networking, compute, IAM, and platform services, accelerating environment rollout and improving consistency.
Designed production-grade AKS clusters using Azure CNI, subnet segmentation, and VNet-integrated networking models for enterprise application platforms.
Implemented Azure Policy controls, tagging standards, and subscription-level governance patterns to improve compliance and platform consistency.
